playstyle.identity: Dr. Mundo is an unkillable tank who regenerates massive health. He uses health as a resource and becomes nearly impossible to kill with his ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Abilities cost health. Passive rejects CC periodically. Q is a slow cleaver. W creates a damage zone and stores damage to convert to healing. E empowers autos and throws. R heals massively over time. Just run at enemies and outlast them.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Mundo spikes at level 6 with his healing ultimate. Tank items with health scale his passive. He's a late-game unkillable tank.

passive.name: Goes Where He Pleases
passive.summary: Periodically immune to one immobilizing effect; drops a canister to heal.
passive.details: Mundo resists the next immobilizing effect and instead loses health and drops a canister. Walking over it heals him and reduces the passive cooldown.

abilities.name: Infected Bonesaw
abilities.summary: Throw a cleaver that damages and slows based on target's current health.
abilities.details: Mundo throws his cleaver, dealing damage based on the target's current health and slowing them. Refunds health if it hits.

abilities.name: Heart Zapper
abilities.summary: Deal damage around you and store damage taken to convert to healing.
abilities.details: Mundo charges an electricity field that damages nearby enemies. While charging, he stores a portion of damage taken. Recast to detonate and heal for the stored damage.

abilities.name: Blunt Force Trauma
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to smash and deal bonus damage based on missing health.
abilities.details: Passive: Mundo gains bonus AD based on missing health. Active: Next auto deals bonus damage and if it kills, Mundo swats the target away.

abilities.name: Maximum Dosage
abilities.summary: Gain massive health regeneration, AD, and size over several seconds.
abilities.details: Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, gaining bonus AD, movement speed, and regenerating a huge portion of his max health over time.
